SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN frpm AS f2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
        AND f2."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
        AND f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT s.School,
       ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, 6) AS eligible_meal_rate
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged';

SELECT sch.MailStreet, sch.School
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
  AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.0018;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT
    f.`District Code`,
    100.0 * f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT DISTINCT AdmEmail1
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND DOCType = 'Unified School District'
  AND SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
  AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01'
  AND OpenDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(AdmEmail1) <> ''
ORDER BY AdmEmail1;

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.CDSCode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE CDSCode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ss.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss
    ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CharterNum = '0756'
  AND s.MailCity = 'San Diego';

SELECT s.School, s.GSserved
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0)
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT sc.School, sc.MailStreet
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.DOC = '02'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.AvgScrRead = (
      SELECT MAX(s2.AvgScrRead)
      FROM schools AS sc2
      JOIN satscores AS s2 ON s2.cds = sc2.CDSCode
      WHERE sc2.DOC = '02'
        AND s2.rtype = 'S'
        AND s2.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT s.School, s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) > 9
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, s.NumTstTakr
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.CDSCode = '1611190130609'
  AND sch.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.County = 'Contra Costa'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > (
      SELECT target.NumTstTakr
      FROM satscores AS target
      WHERE target.cds = '07618040730051'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_schools
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND s.SOCType LIKE '%(Public)'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT 'P' AS lowest_grade_level
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
  AND GSoffered LIKE 'P%'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`, 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
 AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities';

SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '02'
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.NumGE1500)
    FROM schools AS s2
    JOIN satscores AS t2 ON t2.cds = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOC = '02'
      AND t2.rtype = 'S'
  );

SELECT SOCType AS "School Type",
       School AS "School Name",
       Latitude
FROM schools
WHERE (
    SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
    OR School LIKE '%Middle%'
    OR School LIKE '%Junior High%'
)
AND Latitude = (
    SELECT MAX(Latitude)
    FROM schools
    WHERE (
        SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
        OR School LIKE '%Middle%'
        OR School LIKE '%Junior High%'
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS average_test_takers
FROM schools AS sch
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
    ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sch.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND sch.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND sch.DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District',
      'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND sch.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(sch.School) <> '';

SELECT
    s.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) * 100, 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
                 AND sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
                 AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
                THEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.FundingType;

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       f.`Low Grade` AS earliest_grade_level,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS k12_enrollment,
       COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
 AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE f.`Low Grade`
           WHEN 'P' THEN 0
           WHEN 'K' THEN 1
           ELSE CAST(f.`Low Grade` AS INTEGER) + 1
         END DESC,
         f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC,
         s.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.School) <> ''
  AND s.DOCType <> 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND CAST(
        CASE
          WHEN instr(s.GSserved, '-') > 0
            THEN substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1)
          ELSE s.GSserved
        END AS INTEGER
      ) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

SELECT
    f.`Charter Funding Type` AS funding_type,
    COUNT(*) AS currently_operating_schools,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    SUM(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY f.`Charter Funding Type`
ORDER BY CASE f.`Charter Funding Type`
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_sat_schools
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS average_schools_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Diego'
  AND DOC IN ('52', '54', '56')
  AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
  AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved LIKE '%-12'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
highest_rate AS (
    SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS rate
    FROM eligible_schools
)
SELECT
    e.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', e.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE e.Charter
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_status,
    e.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL
          OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL
          OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200
            THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500
            THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible_schools AS e
JOIN highest_rate AS h
    ON e.free_meal_rate = h.rate
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = e.CDSCode;

WITH highest_math AS (
    SELECT MAX(ss.AvgScrMath) AS highest_avg_math
    FROM satscores AS ss
    JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND ss.NumTstTakr >= 10
)
SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Phone AS phone_number,
    s.Website AS website,
    ss.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
    ss.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
    ss.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
    s.Charter AS is_charter,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` * 100, 2) AS percent_eligible_free_or_reduced_price_meals,
    h.highest_avg_math AS highest_active_school_avg_sat_math,
    h.highest_avg_math - ss.AvgScrMath AS math_score_below_highest
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN highest_math AS h
WHERE s.CDSCode = '07618040113118';

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.School, sat.AvgScrRead
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
        ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT County, school_count
    FROM county_counts
    WHERE school_count >= (
        SELECT MIN(school_count)
        FROM (
            SELECT school_count
            FROM county_counts
            ORDER BY school_count DESC
            LIMIT 5
        )
    )
),
county_max_scores AS (
    SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_read
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT
    tc.County AS county_name,
    tc.school_count AS virtual_school_count,
    COALESCE(vs.School, 'None') AS school_name
FROM top_counties AS tc
JOIN county_max_scores AS cm
    ON cm.County = tc.County
LEFT JOIN virtual_schools AS vs
    ON vs.County = tc.County
   AND vs.AvgScrRead = cm.max_read
ORDER BY tc.school_count DESC, tc.County, school_name;

WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '01100170109835'
),
selected_counties AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
    UNION
    SELECT County
    FROM target_county
)
SELECT c.County AS county_name,
       COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_school_count
FROM selected_counties AS c
LEFT JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.County = c.County
   AND s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY c.County
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_school_count DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` + 30
  AND (
    f.`High Grade` = 'K'
    OR (
      f.`High Grade` GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(f.`High Grade` AS INTEGER) <= 8
    )
  );

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Low Grade" IN ('9', '10', '11', '12', 'Adult')
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
ORDER BY s.CDSCode ASC;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE substr(CDSCode, 1, 2) = substr('1611430131177', 1, 2)
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.Zip, sch.State
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(s.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.School AS School,
    s.Street AS Street,
    s.City AS City,
    s.State AS State,
    s.Zip AS Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`School Type` IN (
      'High Schools (Public)',
      'Continuation High Schools',
      'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)'
  )
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 500
ORDER BY s.School;

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
)
SELECT
    qs.County,
    SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_test_takers
FROM qualifying_schools AS qs
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = qs.CDSCode
GROUP BY qs.County;

WITH ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, artist, isPromo
FROM ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts)
ORDER BY name, artist, isPromo;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM foreign_data f
            WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
              AND f.language = 'French'
        ) THEN c.uuid
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS french_translation_percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(c.borderColor) = 'white'
  AND LOWER(l.status) = 'banned';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR c.power LIKE '%*%')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND LOWER(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  );

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(l.format) = 'commander'
  AND LOWER(l.status) = 'legal';

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_printing_records
    FROM legalities
    WHERE LOWER(status) = 'banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    ORDER BY banned_printing_records DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT tf.format, c.name
FROM top_format AS tf
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.format = tf.format
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE LOWER(l.status) = 'banned'
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND leadershipSkills LIKE '%''brawl'': True%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_cards
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10;

WITH translation_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
    FROM set_translations
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT SUM(s.totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE COALESCE(t.translation_count, 0) < 5;

SELECT
    s.type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.translation) <> '' THEN s.code
    END) AS translated_set_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN t.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.translation) <> '' THEN s.totalSetSize
        ELSE 0
    END), 0) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
) AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

WITH target_rulings AS (
  SELECT r.date
  FROM rulings AS r
  JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
  WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
),
latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS date
  FROM target_rulings
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM target_rulings
WHERE date = (SELECT date FROM latest_date);

WITH artist_counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS creature_card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (SELECT MAX(creature_card_count) FROM artist_counts)
ORDER BY artist;

WITH newest_frame AS (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
    GROUP BY frameVersion
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN frameVersion = 'future' THEN 9999
        WHEN frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)
    END DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN newest_frame AS n ON c.frameVersion = n.frameVersion
GROUP BY c.frameVersion;

SELECT
    frameVersion AS frame_version_year,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'), 2) AS percentage_of_printings
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion = 'future';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM legalities AS l
    WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
      AND l.format = 'commander'
      AND l.status = 'Legal'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flying,%'
  AND (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Cycling,%';

SELECT c.name, c.number AS collector_number,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data AS f WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.watermark = 'abzan'
  AND CAST(c.number AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE watermark = 'abzan'
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT name, convertedManaCost
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
      AND ',' || replace(coalesce(keywords, ''), ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,Flash,%'
)
SELECT name
FROM eligible
WHERE convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.name,
       s.keyruneCode,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t
  ON t.setCode = s.code
 AND t.translation IS NOT NULL
 AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.code, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT SUM(s.totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  );

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
rates AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        100.0 * (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2012 AS increase_percentage
    FROM annual
),
extrema AS (
    SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) AS highest, MIN(increase_percentage) AS lowest
    FROM rates
)
SELECT
    r.Segment,
    ROUND(r.increase_percentage, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM rates AS r
CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
WHERE r.increase_percentage = e.highest
   OR r.increase_percentage = e.lowest
ORDER BY r.increase_percentage DESC, r.Segment;

WITH target_customer AS (

),
annual_totals AS (
    SELECT
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption END) AS total_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption END) AS total_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN target_customer AS t ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
)
SELECT ROUND((total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012, 4) AS relative_change
FROM annual_totals;

            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2015-01-01 23:59:59'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
current_records AS (

    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM current_records
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND attacking_work_rate <> 'None';

WITH appearances AS (

    UNION

    UNION
    SELECT m.id, m.home_player_5 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_player_5 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT m.id, m.home_player_6 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_player_6 IS NOT NULL

    UNION

counts AS (

SELECT p.player_name, COALESCE(c.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday > '1990-12-31'
