SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date <= '2007-08-30'
  AND jumping >= 80;

WITH team_info AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS match_date
  FROM Match
  WHERE season = '2012/2013'
    AND (
      home_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_info)
      OR away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_info)
    )
)
SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN team_info AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN last_match AS lm ON ta.date <= lm.match_date
WHERE ta.date = (
  SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
  FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
  WHERE ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    AND ta2.date <= lm.match_date
)
ORDER BY ta.id DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH salary_extremes AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS lowest_salary,
           MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) AS salary_difference
    FROM district
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT MIN(c.birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    CROSS JOIN salary_extremes s
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.A11 = s.lowest_salary
)
SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, s.salary_difference
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
CROSS JOIN salary_extremes s
CROSS JOIN oldest o
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 = s.lowest_salary
  AND c.birth_date = o.oldest_birth_date
ORDER BY dp.account_id;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS male_percentage
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(A4 AS INTEGER))
      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

SELECT
    (end_tx.balance - start_tx.balance) * 100.0 / start_tx.balance AS percentage_increase
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS start_tx
    ON start_tx.account_id = l.account_id
   AND start_tx.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans AS end_tx
    ON end_tx.account_id = l.account_id
   AND end_tx.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROUND((d.A9 - d.A8) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.A8, 0), 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND l.status = 'D'
)
ORDER BY d.A2;

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district AS r ON r.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND r.A11 > 8000
  AND r.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY d.type
ORDER BY d.type;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) AS loan_year,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.date < '1998-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp AS d
          JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
          WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
            AND d.type = 'OWNER'
            AND c.gender = 'M'
      )
    GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
    (1997.0_total - 1996.0_total) * 100.0 / 1996.0_total AS percentage_growth
FROM (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 1996 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 1996_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 1997 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 1997_total
    FROM yearly
);

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol
FROM account AS a
JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT date(MIN(date), 'start of month') AS month_start
    FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    CROSS JOIN first_month AS f
    WHERE date(a.date) >= f.month_start
      AND date(a.date) < date(f.month_start, '+1 month')
)
SELECT d.district_id, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
FROM district AS d
JOIN opened_districts AS od ON od.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(d2.A4 AS INTEGER))
    FROM district AS d2
    JOIN opened_districts AS od2 ON od2.district_id = d2.district_id
)
ORDER BY d.district_id;

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
per_account AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_loan_amount
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        AVG(p.active_loan_amount) AS average_active_loan_per_account
    FROM top_districts AS d
    JOIN per_account AS p ON p.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    ROUND(average_active_loan_per_account) AS average_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_averages
WHERE average_active_loan_per_account = (
    SELECT MAX(average_active_loan_per_account)
    FROM district_averages
)
ORDER BY district_name;

WITH regional_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.date <= '1995-12-31'
      AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= '1995-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM regional_totals);

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT qa.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM qualifying_accounts AS qa
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = qa.account_id
  GROUP BY qa.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM loan_counts;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
      AND bank IS NOT NULL
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
),
borrowing_households AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        lt.total_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
        owner_d.A2 AS home_district,
        CAST(owner_d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS district_population
    FROM account a
    JOIN district branch_d ON branch_d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district owner_d ON owner_d.district_id = c.district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE branch_d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opening_date,
    total_borrowed,
    counterparty_count,
    home_district,
    district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_households
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id;

WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, a.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp dp ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN account_avg aa ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
      AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
      AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
      AND c.gender IN ('F', 'M')
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT ed.gender,
           d.district_id,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM eligible_districts ed
    JOIN district d ON ed.district_id = d.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS max_inhabitants
    FROM district_metrics
)
SELECT CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS gender,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS district_count,
       district_id,
       inhabitants,
       ROUND(AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 2) AS avg_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 2) AS avg_urban_inhabitant_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, district_id;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS x ON x.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'gold'
      AND CAST(x.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account,
        COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN eligible_accounts AS ea ON ea.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        bank,
        account,
        payment_count,
        total_amount,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM totals
)
SELECT
    bank,
    account,
    payment_count,
    total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY bank, account;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '';

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp
      ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS ca
          JOIN disp AS card_dp
            ON card_dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
          WHERE card_dp.account_id = a.account_id
            AND ca.type IN ('classic', 'gold')
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS l
          WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
      )
)
SELECT
    d.A3 AS region,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(d.A11 AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(d.A9 AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    (
        SELECT d2.A2
        FROM district AS d2
        JOIN eligible_districts AS ed2
          ON ed2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE d2.A3 = d.A3
        ORDER BY CAST(d2.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, d2.A2 ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_populous_district
FROM district AS d
JOIN eligible_districts AS ed
  ON ed.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.A3;

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT
        A2 AS district_name,
        CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        CAST(A6 AS INTEGER) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, A2 COLLATE NOCASE
    LIMIT 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) AS three_district_average
    FROM top3
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(A6 AS INTEGER)) AS overall_average
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average, 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(o.overall_average, 2) AS all_district_average,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average - o.overall_average, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 AS t
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC, t.district_name COLLATE NOCASE;

WITH region AS (
    SELECT A3
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.account_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS transaction_rank
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN region AS r
        ON r.A3 = d.A3
    JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT account_id, district_name, balance
    FROM ranked_transactions
    WHERE transaction_rank = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
        ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM account_balances
    GROUP BY district_name
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM account_balances
),
highest_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    'DISTRICT' AS result_type,
    district_name,
    accounts_opened,
    avg_balance
FROM district_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'REGION_AVERAGE',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    avg_balance
FROM region_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'HIGHEST_DISTRICT',
    district_name,
    NULL,
    avg_balance
FROM district_stats
WHERE district_name = (SELECT district_name FROM highest_district)
ORDER BY
    CASE result_type
        WHEN 'DISTRICT' THEN 1
        WHEN 'REGION_AVERAGE' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    district_name;

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
selected_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM top_loans AS t
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
    WHERE t.rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    district_id,
    inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary) OVER (), 2) AS avg_salary_across_districts
FROM selected_districts
ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
district_rankings AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
        ) AS population_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(A2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
        ) AS most_populous_district,
        FIRST_VALUE(CAST(A4 AS INTEGER)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
        ) AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    a.frequency,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    CASE WHEN d.district_id = home.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_client_home_district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rcc.client_count AS clients_in_region,
    dr.most_populous_district,
    dr.most_populous_inhabitants,
    dr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM target_accounts ta
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ta.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client home ON home.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN regional_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = d.A3
JOIN district_rankings dr ON dr.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_district_year AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS creation_year,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(l.amount, 0)) AS loan_amount
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date)
)
SELECT
    creation_year,
    SUM(account_count) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(loan_amount) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(1.0 * loan_amount / account_count), 2)
        AS avg_district_amount_per_account
FROM account_district_year
GROUP BY creation_year
ORDER BY creation_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.A2 AS district,
        l.amount AS approved_amount,
        l.date AS approval_date,
        (
            SELECT t.balance
            FROM trans AS t
            WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
              AND t.date <= l.date
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS account_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC
        ) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT district, approved_amount, approval_date, account_balance
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE loan_rank <= 10
ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, approval_date ASC;

WITH client_cards AS (
    SELECT
        cl.client_id,
        cl.gender,
        cl.birth_date,
        ca.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', ca.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS district_average_salary,
        dp.account_id
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE ca.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND ca.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
account_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiled AS (
    SELECT
        cc.client_id,
        cc.gender,
        cc.birth_date,
        cc.card_type,
        cc.age_at_issue,
        COALESCE(alt.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(alt.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
        CASE
            WHEN alt.number_of_loans IS NOT NULL AND cc.age_at_issue < 30
                THEN 'Young borrower'
            WHEN alt.number_of_loans IS NOT NULL AND cc.age_at_issue >= 30
                THEN 'Mature borrower'
            ELSE 'Non-borrower'
        END AS borrower_classification,
        cc.district_name,
        cc.district_average_salary,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cc.gender
            ORDER BY cc.age_at_issue
        ) AS age_rank_within_gender
    FROM client_cards AS cc
    LEFT JOIN account_loan_totals AS alt ON alt.account_id = cc.account_id
)
SELECT
    client_id,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    card_type,
    age_at_issue,
    number_of_loans,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    borrower_classification,
    district_name,
    district_average_salary,
    age_rank_within_gender
FROM profiled
ORDER BY client_id;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    t.bank AS bank_code,
    t.account AS account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_outgoing_payments,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
  AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
  AND t.account IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 2823
)
AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
AND t.k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        d.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        br.A2 AS branch_district,
        br.A3 AS region,
        l.payments * l.duration AS total_payments
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND c.gender = 'F'
    JOIN district AS br ON br.district_id = a.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
),
account_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_salaries AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.total_payments, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.total_payments - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    r.branch_district,
    r.region,
    COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.loan_count AS region_loan_count,
    rs.average_district_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS t ON t.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN region_loan_counts AS rl ON rl.region = r.region
JOIN region_salaries AS rs ON rs.region = r.region
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
      AND l.duration > 24
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS district_count,
        SUM(CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER)) AS combined_population,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_districts AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
      AND l.duration > 24
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT region, district_count, combined_population, account_count
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11
    FROM district AS d
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM account AS a
          WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
            AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
            AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
            AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
      )
),
account_totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_accounts
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
      ON q.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
)
SELECT
    account_totals.total_accounts,
    COUNT(q.district_id) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(q.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts AS q
CROSS JOIN account_totals;

WITH
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner_profile AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_profile AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
activity_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id,
           ta.opened_date,
           op.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', op.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - CASE
                   WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', op.birth_date)
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END AS age_years,
           COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(lp.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           CASE WHEN lp.loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' ELSE lp.loan_standing END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(a.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(a.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(a.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(a.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM target_accounts AS ta
    JOIN owner_profile AS op ON op.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_profile AS lp ON lp.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity_1997 AS a ON a.account_id = ta.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       age_years,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       transaction_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH classic_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.client_id,
        d.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card AS c
        ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        coa.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT coa.client_id) AS client_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || ':' || t.account) AS external_account_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM classic_owner_accounts AS coa
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = coa.account_id
       AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
       AND t.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'
       AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
       AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY coa.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(dm.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(dm.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(dm.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_metrics AS dm
    ON dm.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
) AS cohort_districts
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cohort_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
    / CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS r853
JOIN results AS r854 ON r853.driverId = r854.driverId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r853.driverId
WHERE r853.raceId = 853
  AND r854.raceId = 854
  AND d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS non_victory_percentage
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT MAX(wins) AS wins
    FROM win_counts
)
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.nationality,
    (SELECT MAX(ds.points)
     FROM driverStandings ds
     WHERE ds.driverId = d.driverId) AS highest_recorded_points
FROM win_counts wc
JOIN max_wins mw ON wc.wins = mw.wins
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = wc.driverId;

WITH race_result AS (
    SELECT x.position, x.laps, x.milliseconds
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS x ON x.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1988
      AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
times AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN milliseconds END) AS winner_ms,
        MAX(CASE WHEN laps = (
            SELECT MAX(laps)
            FROM race_result
            WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
        ) THEN milliseconds END) AS last_full_distance_ms
    FROM race_result
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (last_full_distance_ms - winner_ms) * 100.0 / last_full_distance_ms,
    2
) AS percentage_shorter
FROM times;

SELECT
    r.year,
    ROUND(AVG(res.milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) AS mean_elapsed_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND res.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS score
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, MIN(res.fastestLapTime) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND res.laps > 0
  AND res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

WITH race_stops AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.name, COUNT(p.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
    FROM races r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
    GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS average_pit_stops_per_race
FROM race_stops rs
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM races r2000
    WHERE r2000.year = 2000
      AND r2000.name = rs.name
);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      = (
          SELECT MIN(
              CAST(substr(q1, 1, instr(q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
              + CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
          )
          FROM qualifying
          WHERE raceId = r.raceId
            AND q1 IS NOT NULL
            AND q1 <> ''
      );

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2)
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = r.raceId
      AND q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND re.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, '15:03:55.573' AS finish_time, d.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '');

WITH q2_times AS (
    SELECT
        d.nationality,
        q.q2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q.q2) AS time_rank
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q2_times
WHERE time_rank = 2;

SELECT c.name, c.location, c.country, r.year, p.duration
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE (d.code IS NULL OR trim(d.code) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM drivers AS other
      WHERE other.forename = d.forename
        AND other.driverId <> d.driverId
  )
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) >= 2;

SELECT d.driverRef, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
        AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH editions AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 1990
      AND name = 'French Grand Prix'
),
driver_fastest AS (
    SELECT e.raceId, e.date, d.forename, d.surname,
           MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM editions e
    JOIN lapTimes l ON l.raceId = e.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
    WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.raceId, l.driverId
)
SELECT e.date, f.forename, f.surname,
       CASE WHEN f.fastest_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE printf('%d:%02d.%03d',
                        f.fastest_ms / 60000,
                        (f.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60,
                        f.fastest_ms % 1000)
       END AS fastest_lap
FROM editions e
LEFT JOIN driver_fastest f
    ON f.raceId = e.raceId
   AND f.fastest_ms > 90000
ORDER BY e.date, f.surname, f.forename;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN drivers AS d2 ON d2.driverId = q2.driverId
      WHERE d2.nationality = 'Italian'
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q2.q3) <> ''
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.year AS race_year,
        q.q3 AS q3_time,
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
            + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND d.dob > '1980-12-31'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM eligible);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY raceId
            ORDER BY fastestLapTime
        ) AS lap_rank
    FROM results
    WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.lap_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

WITH event AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017
      AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q3times AS (
    SELECT d.driverRef, q.q3,
           CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
           + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN event AS e ON e.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT driverRef
FROM q3times
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM q3times);

WITH season_final AS (
    SELECT
        cs.constructorId,
        r.year,
        cs.points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
            ORDER BY r.round DESC, r.raceId DESC, cs.constructorStandingsId DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
),
career AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(sf.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_final AS sf
        ON sf.constructorId = c.constructorId
       AND sf.rn = 1
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS points_rank
    FROM career
)
SELECT name, career_points, url
FROM ranked
WHERE points_rank <= 3
ORDER BY points_rank, name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY CASE d.forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 WHEN 'John' THEN 2 END;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q3_ms
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(q3) <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM parsed AS p
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE p.q3_ms = (SELECT MIN(q3_ms) FROM parsed);

SELECT
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN r.rank = 1 AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
        THEN c.constructorId
    END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

SELECT
    r.year AS season,
    COUNT(ps.raceId) AS total_pit_stops
FROM races AS r
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    JOIN drivers AS d
        ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Australian'
      AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
) AS qualifying_races
    ON qualifying_races.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps
    ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) > 120;

SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
    r.name AS race_name,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location AS circuit_location
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01'
  AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
  AND p.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MIN(p2.milliseconds)
      FROM pitStops AS p2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = p2.raceId
      WHERE r2.date >= '2016-09-01'
        AND r2.date < '2016-10-01'
        AND p2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.dob,
        d.nationality
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.position = 1
      AND d.dob IS NOT NULL
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winning_drivers
    ORDER BY dob, forename COLLATE BINARY, surname COLLATE BINARY
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT ra.name, ra.date
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN oldest o ON o.driverId = r.driverId
    WHERE r.position = 1
    ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name COLLATE BINARY
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS total_starts
    FROM results r
    JOIN oldest o ON o.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN status s ON s.statusId = r.statusId
    WHERE s.status NOT IN ('Did not start', 'Did not qualify', 'Did not prequalify')
)
SELECT
    o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS full_name,
    o.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_race_won,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    cs.total_starts
FROM oldest o
CROSS JOIN first_win fw
CROSS JOIN career_starts cs;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

SELECT d.surname, r.name
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2)
      FROM qualifying
      JOIN races ON races.raceId = qualifying.raceId
      WHERE races.year = 2017
        AND qualifying.q2 IS NOT NULL
        AND qualifying.q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.number
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q3)
      FROM qualifying
      WHERE raceId = r.raceId
        AND q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q3) <> ''
  );

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY
  CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
  + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
  + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 1;

WITH selected AS (
    SELECT raceId, year
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
      AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
      AND time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT selected.year, results.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM selected
JOIN results
  ON results.raceId = selected.raceId
WHERE results.positionOrder = 2
  AND results.position = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, re.time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time <= '17:00:00'
  AND re.position = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH timed_races AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitRef,
        CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
        + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
           MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
    FROM timed_races
)
SELECT
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
         FROM timed_races
         WHERE start_seconds = bounds.earliest_seconds
         ORDER BY circuitRef
     )) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
         FROM timed_races
         WHERE start_seconds = bounds.latest_seconds
         ORDER BY circuitRef
     )) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    bounds.latest_seconds - bounds.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM bounds;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC,
         d.dob ASC,
         d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY
  CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) DESC,
  q.driverId;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1957
      AND name = 'British Grand Prix'
),
drivers AS (
    SELECT res.driverId,
           MAX(CASE
                   WHEN res.positionText GLOB '[0-9]*'
                    AND res.positionText NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END) AS classified
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN target_race AS tr ON tr.raceId = res.raceId
    GROUP BY res.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(classified) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM drivers;

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(x.cost) AS total_expense
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN member AS m ON x.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget AS b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', x.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_expense), 2) AS mean_total_expense_per_event
FROM per_event;

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND e.event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND e.event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_amount_difference
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 7;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e.link_to_member = m.member_id
      AND e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
);

WITH fall_events AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendees
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
fall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(attendees) AS avg_attendance
    FROM fall_events
),
soccer AS (
    SELECT attendees
    FROM fall_events
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
)
SELECT
    soccer.attendees AS womens_soccer_attendance,
    ROUND(fall_average.avg_attendance, 1) AS fall_2019_average_attendance,
    CASE
        WHEN soccer.attendees > ROUND(fall_average.avg_attendance, 1) THEN 'more'
        WHEN soccer.attendees < ROUND(fall_average.avg_attendance, 1) THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM soccer
CROSS JOIN fall_average;

SELECT
    d.department,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Engineering'
) AS d
LEFT JOIN major AS j
    ON j.department = d.department
   AND j.college = 'College of Engineering'
LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id
   AND m.position = 'Member'
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
   AND i.source = 'Dues'
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM attendance AS a
       WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id
   )
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY d.department;

WITH qualifying_member_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
      AND link_to_member IS NOT NULL
      AND link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(b.remaining), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM qualifying_member_budget_lines q
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM major AS m
WHERE m.college = (
    SELECT tyler_major.college
    FROM member AS tyler
    JOIN major AS tyler_major
      ON tyler.link_to_major = tyler_major.major_id
    WHERE tyler.first_name = 'Tyler'
      AND tyler.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM member AS enrolled
    WHERE enrolled.link_to_major = m.major_id
);

WITH advertising_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'Advertisement'
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_event, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM advertising_events AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS average_attendees
FROM attendance_counts;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_name;

SELECT m.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
GROUP BY m.major_id, m.major_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) = (
    SELECT MAX(major_attendees)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member) AS major_attendees
        FROM event e2
        JOIN attendance a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
        JOIN member mb2 ON mb2.member_id = a2.link_to_member
        JOIN major m2 ON m2.major_id = mb2.link_to_major
        WHERE e2.event_name = 'Football game'
        GROUP BY m2.major_id
    )
)
ORDER BY m.major_name;

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
                THEN 'officer'
            ELSE 'other student'
        END AS group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
    FROM member AS m
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT
    group_name,
    ROUND(AVG(events_attended), 2) AS average_events_attended
FROM member_attendance
GROUP BY group_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(trim(item.value))) AS item_kind_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN expense AS ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN json_each(
    '["' || replace(replace(ex.expense_description, '"', ''), ', ', '","') || '"]'
) AS item
WHERE b.remaining < 0;

WITH attendee_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_costs AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(e.cost) AS water_cost
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
    WHERE lower(e.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    ev.event_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_cost, 0.0) / a.attendee_count, 2) AS amount_per_attendee
FROM event AS ev
JOIN attendee_counts AS a ON a.event_id = ev.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_costs AS w ON w.event_id = ev.event_id
ORDER BY ev.event_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS members_majoring_in_college,
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS members_not_majoring_in_college
FROM member
LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

SELECT expense_date, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_member IN (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Vice President'
)
  AND expense_date = (
      SELECT MAX(e.expense_date)
      FROM expense AS e
      WHERE e.link_to_member IN (
          SELECT member_id
          FROM member
          WHERE position = 'Vice President'
      )
  )
GROUP BY expense_date;

SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT ma.college, COUNT(*) AS major_count
  FROM member AS me
  JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = me.link_to_major
  GROUP BY ma.college
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM college_counts
WHERE major_count = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college;

WITH qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount > 40
),
purchased_things AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ev.location,
        TRIM(j.value) AS thing
    FROM qualifying_events qe
    JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = qe.link_to_event
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = qe.link_to_event
    JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN json_each(
        '["' || REPLACE(
            REPLACE(x.expense_description, '"', '\"'),
            ', ',
            '","'
        ) || '"]'
    ) AS j
)
SELECT location, COUNT(DISTINCT thing) AS number_of_different_things
FROM purchased_things
GROUP BY location;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE ev.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND ev.event_date < '2019-10-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM expense ex
      WHERE ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
        AND ex.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spend), 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS event_spend
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
);

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ev.event_id,
        ev.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS ev
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE ev.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY ev.event_id, ev.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT et.event_name
FROM event_totals AS et
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts AS pc ON pc.event_id = et.event_id
WHERE et.total_spending <= et.total_budget
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.purchase_count, 0) DESC, et.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.type AS event_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
GROUP BY e.type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) = (
    SELECT MAX(member_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member) AS member_count
        FROM event AS e2
        JOIN attendance AS a2
          ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
        WHERE e2.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
          AND e2.event_date < '2020-06-01'
        GROUP BY e2.type
    )
);

WITH RECURSIVE approved_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        e.expense_id,
        e.expense_description,
        e.cost,
        b.category
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
    JOIN event AS ev
        ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'
),
item_parts(expense_id, item, rest, cost, category) AS (
    SELECT
        expense_id,
        '',
        trim(expense_description) || ',',
        cost,
        category
    FROM approved_purchases
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        expense_id,
        trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)),
        substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1),
        cost,
        category
    FROM item_parts
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
item_costs AS (
    SELECT
        item,
        category,
        SUM(cost) AS total_cost
    FROM item_parts
    WHERE item <> ''
    GROUP BY item, category, expense_id, cost
)
SELECT
    item AS item_name,
    category AS budget_category,
    SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost_dollars
FROM item_costs
GROUP BY category, item
ORDER BY category, item;

WITH budget_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget,
    COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN budget_totals AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN attendance_counts AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND member.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY expense_description
ORDER BY item_name;

WITH item_kinds AS (
    SELECT
        e.link_to_member AS member_id,
        LOWER(TRIM(j.value)) AS item_kind
    FROM expense AS e,
         json_each(
             '["' || REPLACE(
                 REPLACE(LOWER(e.expense_description), '"', '\\"'),
                 ',',
                 '","'
             ) || '"]'
         ) AS j
    WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
kind_counts AS (
    SELECT member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT item_kind) AS kind_count
    FROM item_kinds
    GROUP BY member_id
),
spending AS (
    SELECT link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        kind_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY kind_count DESC) AS kind_rank
    FROM kind_counts
)
SELECT
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    r.kind_count,
    s.total_spending
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = r.member_id
JOIN spending AS s ON s.member_id = r.member_id
WHERE r.kind_rank = 1
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT maj.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member AS mem
JOIN major AS maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE maj.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT
    c.colour AS eye_colour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p
    ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS c
    ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(c.colour) <> ''
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT h.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = h.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
ORDER BY h.superhero_name;

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT 'Marvel Comics' AS publisher_with_more, 163 AS difference;

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND eye_colour_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_marvel
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p
    ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.eye_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END) >
              SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END)
         THEN 'Marvel Comics by ' ||
              (SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END) -
               SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END))
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END) >
              SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END)
         THEN 'DC Comics by ' ||
              (SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END) -
               SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count ELSE 0 END))
         ELSE 'Tie'
       END AS result
FROM (
  SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
  GROUP BY p.publisher_name
);

WITH strength_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_id = (
        SELECT id
        FROM attribute
        WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'
    )
),
strength_only_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
      AND hp.power_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM hero_power other_hp
          WHERE other_hp.power_id = hp.power_id
            AND other_hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count
FROM strength_only_powers;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

WITH power_counts AS (
  SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
  JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
    AND sp.power_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sp.id, sp.power_name
)
SELECT power_name, hero_count
FROM power_counts
WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM power_counts)
ORDER BY power_name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(s.weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha_ab.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS ab
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha_ab ON ha_ab.hero_id = ab.id
      JOIN attribute AS a_ab ON a_ab.id = ha_ab.attribute_id
      WHERE ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
        AND a_ab.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 0) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT hulk_strength.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS h
      JOIN hero_attribute AS hulk_strength ON hulk_strength.hero_id = h.id
      JOIN attribute AS strength_attr ON strength_attr.id = hulk_strength.attribute_id
      WHERE h.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND strength_attr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
      AND height_cm <> 0
),
tallest AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.power_name)
FROM tallest t
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = t.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND s.race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT shared.hero_id
        FROM hero_power shared
        WHERE shared.power_id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM superpower
            WHERE power_name = 'Cryokinesis'
        )
    )
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS dc ON dc.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS dc_eye ON dc_eye.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE dc.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS m
      JOIN publisher AS marvel ON marvel.id = m.publisher_id
      JOIN colour AS marvel_eye ON marvel_eye.id = m.eye_colour_id
      WHERE marvel.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
        AND marvel_eye.colour = dc_eye.colour
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm <> 0;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0
  AND s.race_id IN (
      SELECT s2.race_id
      FROM superhero AS s2
      WHERE s2.race_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY s2.race_id
      HAVING SUM(
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gender AS g
              WHERE g.id = s2.gender_id
                AND g.gender = 'Female'
          ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ) = 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM publisher AS p
      WHERE p.id = s.publisher_id
        AND p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
  COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.publisher_id = 13
  AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS other
      WHERE other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
        AND other.publisher_id <> 13

  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')
      AND hp.hero_id IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT gender.gender,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_powers
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender ON gender.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE power_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
WHERE gender.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY gender.gender;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm IS NOT NULL AND s.height_cm <> 0 THEN s.height_cm END), 2) AS avg_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND s.weight_kg <> 0 THEN s.weight_kg END), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(s.height_cm, 0)), 1) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(s.weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
),
shared_power_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN target t ON hp.hero_id = t.id
  WHERE hp.power_id IS NOT NULL
),
matching_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN shared_power_ids sp ON sp.power_id = hp.power_id
  JOIN target t ON hp.hero_id <> t.id
  WHERE hp.hero_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM matching_heroes mh
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = mh.hero_id
WHERE s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm <> 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

WITH min_weight AS (
    SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0
),
hero_counts AS (
    SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN min_weight AS m ON h.weight_kg = m.weight_kg
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp
        ON hp.hero_id = h.id AND hp.power_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count) AS max_power_count
FROM hero_counts;

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

SELECT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS hero
JOIN colour AS eye_colour
  ON eye_colour.id = hero.eye_colour_id
WHERE hero.hair_colour_id <> (
    SELECT id
    FROM colour
    WHERE colour = 'Brown'
)

    SELECT DISTINCT brown_hero.eye_colour_id
