    JOIN colour AS hair_colour
      ON hair_colour.id = brown_hero.hair_colour_id
    WHERE hair_colour.colour = 'Brown'
)
GROUP BY eye_colour.id, eye_colour.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour.colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
),
target_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN target AS t ON hp.hero_id = t.id
    WHERE hp.power_id IS NOT NULL
),
matching_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN target_powers AS tp ON hp.power_id = tp.power_id
    JOIN target AS t ON hp.hero_id <> t.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM matching_heroes AS mh
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = mh.hero_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL OR s.weight_kg = 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.ALB), 4) AS avg_ALB
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.PLT > 400
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-51 years');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Admission
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
      AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT l.`T-BIL`, l.Date, p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL

    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
titers AS (
    SELECT l.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) AS rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP != 'negative'
)
SELECT ID, rnp_titer
FROM titers
WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM titers)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  );

WITH patient_labs AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(l.Date) AS lab_date_count
  FROM Patient AS p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    )
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(lab_date_count), 2) AS average_lab_test_dates
FROM patient_labs
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 16
)
SELECT p.Admission, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN elevated AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
  );

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory l
            WHERE l.ID = cohort.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) THEN cohort.ID
    END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory l
            WHERE l.ID = cohort.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) THEN cohort.ID
    END) AS patients_never_normal
FROM cohort;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.TP - 8.5), 3) AS avg_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS E
    WHERE E.ID = P.ID
      AND E.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND E.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
      AND E.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%->%'
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN date(Birthday) >= '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE lower(Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
  AND Birthday IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(substr(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ID IN (
      SELECT l.ID
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE (l.`U-PRO` IN ('3', '4') AND l.Date < '1987-01-01')
         OR (l.`U-PRO` IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND l.Date >= '1987-01-01')
  );

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 32
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT MIN(
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
) AS youngest_age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
  AND l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  );

SELECT
    COUNT(l.ID) AS total_laboratory_tests,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_laboratory_tests
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND e.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND e.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01'
  AND e.Thrombosis BETWEEN 1 AND 3;

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
  AND (',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(p.Diagnosis, char(29), ','), ' ', '') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(first_exam) - julianday("First Date"))) AS average_delay_days
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID,
           p."First Date",
           MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_exam
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'APS'
      AND instr(p.Admission, '+') > 0
      AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
      AND e."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.ID, p."First Date"
);

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
      AND l.Date <= '1994-12-31'
      AND l.GOT < 60
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
    AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.UN < 30
    )
);

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_high_creatinine,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH group_max AS (
  SELECT p.Admission, MAX(l."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.Admission
)
SELECT gm.max_tcho AS "T-CHO", p.Admission, p.ID
FROM group_max AS gm
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = gm.Admission
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
 AND l."T-CHO" = gm.max_tcho
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END, p.ID;

WITH patient_levels AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS rnp_level
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.`First Date` >= '1991-01-01'
    AND p.`First Date` < '1992-01-01'
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT ID, rnp_level AS RNP
FROM patient_levels
WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) FROM patient_levels)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT
  CASE p.Admission
    WHEN '+' THEN 'hospital admission'
    WHEN '-' THEN 'outpatient clinic'
  END AS care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (
        CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 30
        OR l.`U-PRO` IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000')
      )
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT l.ID
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN latest AS x
    ON l.ID = x.ID
   AND l.Date = x.max_date
WHERE l.Date > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS s
WHERE s.SSA IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS u
      WHERE u.ID = s.ID
        AND u.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(u.`U-PRO`) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(RNP) <> '';

SELECT CASE p.SEX
           WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
           WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
       END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.HGB < 7.0
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE GOT >= 60
        AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (
          TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) IN ('3', '4')
          OR (
            TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) GLOB '[0-9]*'
            AND CAST(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) AS REAL) >= 300
          )
          OR (
            TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) LIKE '>=%'
            AND CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`), 3) AS REAL) >= 300
          )
        )
    )
  );

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
)
SELECT
    CASE Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS "patient group",
    COUNT(*) AS "number of normal lactate dehydrogenase measurements"
FROM cohort
JOIN Laboratory USING (ID)
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND LDH < 500
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY CASE Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_without_recorded_sex,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory AS l
           WHERE l.ID = p.ID
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_any_laboratory_record,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory AS l
           WHERE l.ID = p.ID
             AND l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS h ON h.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND h.HGB < 10
),
patient_max_rnp AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP != 'negative'
    GROUP BY l.ID
),
overall_max AS (
    SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS level
    FROM patient_max_rnp
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, m.highest_rnp
FROM patient_max_rnp AS m
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = m.ID
JOIN overall_max AS o ON m.highest_rnp = o.level;

WITH first_lab AS (
  SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS first_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab AS f
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = f.ID
 AND l.Date = f.first_date
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        `U-PRO`,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    r.Date,
    r.`U-PRO`
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH rnp_positive AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 0
),
no_thrombosis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM rnp_positive
JOIN no_thrombosis USING (ID);

WITH elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
normal AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM elevated e
JOIN normal n ON n.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY n.max_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PT < 14
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16
  );

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.`T-BIL` >= 1.2
  )
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE
            WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
            ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND Birthday <= '1976-10-09'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 4
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(CASE WHEN elevated.ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_result_at_least_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN elevated.ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM cohort
LEFT JOIN elevated USING (ID)
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH latest_labs AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN latest_labs l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

WITH sle_patient_max AS (
    SELECT P.ID, P.Diagnosis, MAX(CAST(L.DNA AS REAL)) AS max_dna_numeric
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
      AND L.DNA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(L.DNA) <> ''
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.Diagnosis
),
overall_max AS (
    SELECT MAX(max_dna_numeric) AS value
    FROM sle_patient_max
)
SELECT s.ID, s.Diagnosis,
       (
           SELECT L.DNA
           FROM Laboratory AS L
           WHERE L.ID = s.ID
             AND CAST(L.DNA AS REAL) = s.max_dna_numeric
           ORDER BY L.Date
           LIMIT 1
       ) AS highest_anti_dna_result
FROM sle_patient_max AS s
JOIN overall_max AS m ON s.max_dna_numeric = m.value
ORDER BY s.ID;

WITH latest_igg AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        IGG,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
settings AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE Admission
            WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN latest_igg.IGG > 900 AND latest_igg.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM settings
LEFT JOIN latest_igg
    ON settings.ID = latest_igg.ID
   AND latest_igg.rn = 1
GROUP BY setting
ORDER BY CASE setting
    WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
END;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis > 0
),
ranked_labs AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN cohort AS c ON c.ID = l.ID
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS female_minus_male
FROM ranked_labs AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn,
           l.RNP,
           l.CPK
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%';

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'
ORDER BY julianday("First Date") - julianday(Birthday) DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(`aCL IgM`), 1)
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1993-10-01'
  AND `Examination Date` <= '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%';

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.Admission,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END AS age
    FROM cohort c
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = c.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    Admission,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_age
FROM patient_ages
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY CASE Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS number_of_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.`aCL IgM`), 2)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND (
    p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SJS susp%'
    OR INSTR(p.Diagnosis, CHAR(11) || CHAR(29) || 'SJS') > 0
  )
  AND e.`aCL IgM` <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS female_patients
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(l.RNP) = '0')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS sm
    WHERE sm.ID = l.ID
      AND sm.SM IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = l.ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = l.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
)
AND CASE
    WHEN l.`U-PRO` IS NULL OR l.`U-PRO` IN ('-', 'TR') THEN 0
    WHEN l.`U-PRO` LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.`U-PRO`, INSTR(l.`U-PRO`, '(') + 1) AS REAL)
    WHEN l.`U-PRO` LIKE '>=%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.`U-PRO`, 3) AS REAL)
    ELSE CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS REAL)
END >= 30;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
      AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(p.Birthday) <= date('2026-10-09')
      AND date(p.Birthday, '+70 years') > date('2026-10-09')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(Birthday)) / 365.2425),
    1
)
FROM eligible_patients;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
           1
       ) AS women_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CPK >= 250
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
  ) < 50
  AND l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
  AND l.`U-PRO` NOT IN ('-', '0', '-15');

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
    SELECT q.molecule_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM qualifying q
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = q.molecule_id
    GROUP BY q.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
    AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(element_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS element_count
        FROM atom AS a2
        JOIN molecule AS m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '-'
        GROUP BY a2.element
    )
)
ORDER BY a.element;

WITH participating AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
     FROM participating p
     JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = p.atom_id
     WHERE a.element = 'i') AS iodine_atoms,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
     FROM participating p
     JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = p.atom_id
     WHERE a.element = 's') AS sulfur_atoms;

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond_counts
  ORDER BY n DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE most_common.bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 'single'
    WHEN '=' THEN 'double'
    WHEN '#' THEN 'triple'
    ELSE most_common.bond_type
  END AS bond_type,
  CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM most_common
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = 'TR010';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a2.molecule_id
    FROM atom a2
    WHERE a2.element IN ('p', 'br')
      AND a2.molecule_id IN (
          SELECT b.molecule_id
          FROM bond b
          JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
          WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      )
);

WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN eligible_molecules AS e
    ON a.molecule_id = e.molecule_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(a.element) = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_fraction,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND b.bond_type = '='
      AND a1.element = 'c'
      AND a2.element = 'c'
);

WITH connected_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM connected
  UNION
  SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
participating_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected_atoms AS ca ON ca.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY a.element
),
top_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM participating_counts
  WHERE atom_count = (SELECT MAX(atom_count) FROM participating_counts)
),
all_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY a.element
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(atom_count) AS atom_count FROM all_atoms
)
SELECT te.element AS most_common_element,
       ROUND(100.0 * aa.atom_count / total.atom_count, 2) AS percentage_of_all_atoms
FROM top_elements AS te
JOIN all_atoms AS aa ON aa.element = te.element
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY te.element;

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bonds
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT
  CASE b.bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 'single'
    WHEN '=' THEN 'double'
    WHEN '#' THEN 'triple'
  END AS bond_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#')
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE b.bond_type
  WHEN '-' THEN 1
  WHEN '=' THEN 2
  WHEN '#' THEN 3
END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 's' THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
END) AS atom_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  AND (a.element = 's' OR a2.element = 's');

WITH unique_element_molecules AS (
    SELECT element, MIN(molecule_id) AS molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IS NOT NULL
      AND molecule_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM unique_element_molecules
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_molecules
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n
    WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND n.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = n.atom_id
      OR c.atom_id2 = n.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b
      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND n.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
);

WITH endpoints AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        substr(bond_id, 7, instr(substr(bond_id, 7), '_') - 1) AS atom1_num,
        substr(bond_id, 7 + instr(substr(bond_id, 7), '_')) AS atom2_num
    FROM bond
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM endpoints e
JOIN atom a
    ON a.molecule_id = e.molecule_id
   AND a.atom_id IN (
       e.molecule_id || '_' || e.atom1_num,
       e.molecule_id || '_' || e.atom2_num
   )
WHERE a.element = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
classified AS (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS t USING (molecule_id)
    WHERE m.label IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    label,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM classified
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label DESC;

WITH atom_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
   AND c.atom_id < c.atom_id2
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         m.label,
         ac.num_atoms,
         COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
         ac.carbon_atoms,
         ac.chlorine_atoms,
         COALESCE(cb.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
         COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_bonds cb ON cb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
         ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
       ) AS rank_position,
       molecule_id,
       label,
       num_atoms,
       num_bonds,
       carbon_atoms,
       chlorine_atoms,
       carbon_touching_bonds,
       multiple_bonds
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY rank_position;

WITH yttrium_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE lower(element) = 'y'
),
bond_endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    CAST(substr(
      b.bond_id,
      length(b.molecule_id) + 2,
      instr(substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2), '_') - 1
    ) AS INTEGER) AS endpoint1,
    CAST(substr(
      b.bond_id,
      length(b.molecule_id) + instr(substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2), '_') + 2
    ) AS INTEGER) AS endpoint2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN yttrium_molecules ym ON ym.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM bond_endpoints b
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    AND lower(a.element) = 'h'
    AND a.atom_id IN (
      b.molecule_id || '_' || b.endpoint1,
      b.molecule_id || '_' || b.endpoint2
    )
);

WITH bond_elements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         b.bond_id,
         CASE WHEN a1.element = 'c' THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS element
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = '-'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
    AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
    AND a1.element IS NOT NULL
    AND a2.element IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM bond_elements
GROUP BY element;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom AS a
      WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond AS b
      WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond AS b
      WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        AND b.bond_type <> '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_flags AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_single,
           MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_multiple
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_single,
           MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_multiple
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id2
),
atom_flags AS (
    SELECT atom_id,
           MAX(has_single) AS has_single,
           MAX(has_multiple) AS has_multiple
    FROM atom_bond_flags
    GROUP BY atom_id
)
SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN atom_flags f ON f.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE f.has_single = 1
  AND f.has_multiple = 0
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.element IS NOT NULL
  AND a.molecule_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND a.element IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
